content_sections.heading: HLL Associate Manager Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 1 vacancy is available - 1 for the Associate Manager post.

content_sections.heading: HLL Associate Manager Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Post Name: Associate Manager Qualifications: Degree in Law Experience: 1 year experience in the Corporate Legal Department of Central/State PSUs or large commercial organizations.

content_sections.heading: HLL Associate Manager Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Maximum Age: 37 years as on 01.07.2026 Age Relaxation: As per Government of India directives for SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates.

content_sections.heading: HLL Associate Manager Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Basic pay range: Rs. 25000 - 45000/- Gross Salary: Rs. 53175.00 (Metro) (approx.) at the minimum of the scale. Annual CTC: Rs. 7.58 Lakhs (Metro) (approx.) at the minimum of the scale.

content_sections.heading: HLL Associate Manager Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
HLL Associate Manager Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Submission of Board Agenda's for various HLL's meetings to the directors at MoHFW Drafting and Vetting of various kinds of Agreements, MOU's, Lease Deed, Power of Attorneys (POA), Indemnity Bond, BGs, Consortium Agreements, EOI's and Tender Documents etc. Rendering legal advice/ opinion in the matters/ cases assigned to Legal Department. Preparing Legal Compliance Report and updation of case status on weekly basis. Engaging of Counsels to defend the cases of the Company in various Courts and Arbitration & Conciliations matters. Court Cases Drafting / reply to Legal Notices, Complaints, Preparation of all requisite documents/pleadings such as facts/ event of the case, petition, Affidavits, suit, reply, rejoinder & evidence, etc, including visits to various High Courts as well as lower courts, MSME Tribunals etc. Holding conferences with the dealing officers and Company Counsels in connection to various cases. Attending and handling Arbitration and Conciliation proceedings. Examination/ analysis of the facts of the Arbitration and Conciliation cases and furnishing the same to the Management and Company Counsels for preparation of Claims and Counter Claims etc.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of HLL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.answer: The last date to apply for the HLL ASSOCIATE MANAGER (LEGAL) recruitment is 12th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the ASSOCIATE MANAGER (LEGAL) post is a Degree in Law. Additionally, candidates must possess 1 year of experience in a Corporate Legal Department.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the ASSOCIATE MANAGER (LEGAL) position is 37 years as of 1st July 2026. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India directives.
